ModMetaData.name: FPS & TPS
ModMetaData.author: anno
ModMetaData.description:
FPS & TPS for RimWorld 1.7 by anno.
在右下角原生时间控制栏上方显示 FPS 和实际 TPS，无需开发者模式。 支持详细设置：独立刷新间隔、目标 TPS、达标比例、帧/刻耗时、横向/纵向布局、字体、间距、宽度、背景、颜色和阈值。 支持地图与世界地图、暂停识别，以及中文和英文。采样和文本缓存专为低开销设计，无逐 tick 补丁。
Native bottom-right FPS and actual TPS counters, with detailed settings and Chinese/English localization. No developer mode needed. No per-tick patches; reuses the game's FPS timing, samples tick deltas, and caches display text.
Requires Harmony for RimWorld 1.7. This is an independent implementation inspired by the display idea of FPS And TPS, not an update of its code.
